daily.brief: 過去約31小時（19日19:30到21日03:02）有215則帖、93個帳號，看淡觀點明顯多過看好（102對56）。最乾淨的共同看好只有AMZN和INTU，各2個帳號、零看淡。NVDA仍是最大熱點，45則帖中5個看好對7個看淡；ANT也有32則帖但偏看淡。
daily.full:
共識

AMZN是這段最乾淨的看好之一，2個帳號支持、沒有看淡，5則帖。@TheTranscript_ 引用執行長談AWS：需提前為資料中心、伺服器及網路設備投入大量資本支出，短期自由現金流有阻力，但長期經濟效益強勁。原帖。@Jason 則說基於本益比，這是多年來買入科技股的最佳時機，喜歡在最大市場有最佳產品和利潤率的公司。原帖。

INTU同樣2個帳號看好。@TheValueist 分析2027財年第一季：QuickBooks線上生態系統增長20%、中市場41%、支付量33%，顯示AI強化平台。原帖。@tenet_research 指出收入同比增長12.1%，毛利率77.2%，營業利潤和淨收入都穩健。原帖。

共同看淡

BMNR有2個帳號看淡。@alphatrends 說有人在BMNR的以太坊上虧了整整100億美元，但因為在「質押」所以沒問題。原帖。@DougKass 指出由Tom Lee經營的BMNR從高點下跌91%，質疑CNBC出現頻率是否與糟糕表現相關。原帖。

HOOD和IREN也各有2個看淡。@Jake__Wujastyk 說HOOD連續9根紅色週蠟燭收盤，IREN則突破對角趨勢區域向下。原帖。@capitalflows 把HOOD、IREN等和NBIS、ASTS放在一起，認為都在本週期見頂，最終至少下跌80-90%，是流動性加敘事的產物。原帖。

MRVL和ORCL同樣2個看淡。@MikeZaccardi 列出從52週高點回撤，MRVL -58%、ORCL -56%。原帖。@garyblack00 以MRVL收購LITE為例，說明用自己股票買另一家公司出錯，一個多月內MRVL下跌45%。原帖。

分歧

NVDA是絕對主角，45則帖、31個帳號，split裡5個看好對7個看淡。@Beth_Kindig 認為FY28收入增長指引從70%上調至75%（基數更高），消除了AI交易放緩的擔憂，Rubin第一季幾乎是Blackwell的兩倍。原帖。@JerryCap 發帖說不敢相信會以買NVDA相同的倍數賣出GPN。原帖。但看淡一方人數稍多，整體仍分裂。

ANT有32則帖，1個看好對5個看淡。@GerberKawasaki 認為Anthropic IPO會成為像Alphabet一樣的藍籌股。原帖。但@KarelMercx 說這是教科書式的IPO，有史以來最大的10個美國IPO中100%在365天後低於首日高點，因此在2027年11月19日將交易低於$113.40。原帖。@WheelieInvestor 則比較VIX的交易方式，認為IPO週被VIX超越90%看起來不太好。原帖。

其他值得留意

這段短時間看淡觀點佔優，AI鏈和加密相關名字壓力較大，而AMZN、INTU有較乾淨的支持。215則帖來自93個帳號。

今日重點

過去31小時看淡觀點較多，AMZN和INTU各有2個帳號共識看好，談的是AWS長期資本支出和Intuit的增長與利潤率。NVDA 45則帖中5看好對7看淡，Beth_Kindig看好指引上調，但整體仍分裂。BMNR被點名以太坊虧損和從高點大跌。

一週來看TGT獲10個帳號共識，零售改善延續；一個月SOFI和TGT也各有10個支持，但NVDA大票持續有分歧。

daily.brief: Over the past ~31 hours (19:30 on the 19th to 03:02 on the 21st) there were 215 posts from 93 accounts, with clearly more bearish views than bullish (102 vs 56). The cleanest joint bullish are only AMZN and INTU, each with 2 accounts and zero bearish. NVDA remains the biggest hotspot with 45 posts, 5 bullish vs 7 bearish; ANT also had 32 posts but skewed bearish.
daily.full:
Consensus

AMZN is one of the cleanest bullish this period, 2 supportive accounts with no bearish, 5 posts. @TheTranscript_ quoted the CEO on AWS: need to invest heavily upfront in data centers, servers and networking, creating short-term free cash flow headwinds but strong long-term economics and returns. original post. @Jason said based on P/E this is the best time in years to buy tech stocks, favoring companies with the best products and margins in the largest markets. original post.

INTU also has 2 bullish accounts. @TheValueist analyzed Q1 FY2027: QuickBooks Online ecosystem +20%, mid-market +41%, payment volume +33%, showing AI-enhanced platform. original post. @tenet_research noted revenue +12.1% YoY, 77.2% gross margin, solid operating and net income. original post.

Joint Bearish

BMNR has 2 bearish accounts. @alphatrends said someone lost a full $10 billion on Ethereum via BMNR but it's fine because they are "staking". original post. @DougKass noted BMNR run by Tom Lee is down 91% from highs and questioned whether poor performance is related to CNBC appearance frequency. original post.

HOOD and IREN also have 2 bearish each. @Jake__Wujastyk said HOOD has 9 consecutive red weekly candles closing, IREN broke down from a diagonal trend zone. original post. @capitalflows grouped HOOD, IREN with NBIS, ASTS etc., saying they all topped this cycle and will eventually drop at least 80-90%, products of liquidity plus narrative. original post.

MRVL and ORCL likewise have 2 bearish. @MikeZaccardi listed drawdowns from 52-week highs, MRVL -58%, ORCL -56%. original post. @garyblack00 used MRVL's acquisition of LITE as an example of buying another company with your own stock going wrong, MRVL down 45% in a little over a month. original post.

Divergence

NVDA is the absolute protagonist with 45 posts and 31 accounts; in the split 5 bullish vs 7 bearish. @Beth_Kindig sees FY28 revenue growth guide raised from 70% to 75% (on a higher base) as removing concerns of AI trade slowdown, with Rubin Q1 nearly double Blackwell. original post. @JerryCap posted he can't believe he would sell GPN at the same multiple he buys NVDA. original post. But the bearish side has slightly more accounts, still split overall.

ANT has 32 posts, 1 bullish vs 5 bearish. @GerberKawasaki thinks the Anthropic IPO will become a blue-chip like Alphabet. original post. But @KarelMercx said this is a textbook IPO; of the 10 largest US IPOs ever, 100% traded below their first-day high after 365 days, so on Nov 19 2027 Anthropic will trade below $113.40. original post. @WheelieInvestor compared VIX trading and said being surpassed by VIX 90% in the IPO week doesn't look good. original post.

Other Noteworthy

This short period has more bearish views dominating, with pressure on the AI chain and crypto-related names, while AMZN and INTU have cleaner support. 215 posts from 93 accounts.

briefing.html:
Today's Highlights

Over the past 31 hours bearish views were more numerous. AMZN and INTU each have consensus from 2 accounts, discussing AWS long-term capex and Intuit's growth plus margins. NVDA 45 posts with 5 bullish vs 7 bearish; Beth_Kindig is positive on the guide raise but overall still split. BMNR was flagged for Ethereum losses and a large drop from highs.

Over the week TGT has consensus from 10 accounts with retail improvement continuing; over the month SOFI and TGT also each have 10 supportive, but NVDA large names continue to diverge.
